cases.title: Linux permissions terminal challenge
cases.brief: An isolated fictional Linux reporting service cannot read its report. Enter read-only diagnostic commands, then state the root cause.
cases.answer: The report is readable only by root while the service uses a different identity.
cases.remediation: Grant the reporting service a narrowly scoped approved read permission, then verify access.
diagnoses: Service identity cannot read the root-owned report file
actions: Grant a narrowly scoped approved read permission and verify the service
Disable Linux access controls for everyone
cases.verification: Recheck file access as the service identity and confirm the reporting workflow succeeds

cases.title: Network DNS terminal challenge
cases.brief: A simulated training laptop reaches its gateway, but the course portal cannot resolve.
cases.answer: The configured DNS resolver 192.168.70.53 is failing; the alternate resolver works.
cases.remediation: Review the approved DNS resolver configuration and retest name resolution.
diagnoses: The configured DNS resolver fails while an alternative works
The gateway has no IP connectivity
actions: Review the approved resolver setting, then repeat name-resolution and portal checks
cases.verification: Resolve the portal using the configured resolver and verify portal access

cases.title: Windows event analysis terminal challenge
cases.brief: Investigate synthetic login records without claiming compromise without evidence.

commands.eventlog auth: 09:00 failed student; 09:01 failed student; 09:05 success student
commands.eventlog defender: No detection in supplied time window

cases.answer: The log pattern is consistent with an authorized reset; account takeover is not established.
cases.remediation: Confirm account-owner activity and retain only relevant authorized evidence.
diagnoses: These records support an authorized reset explanation; takeover is not established
The events prove a successful attacker takeover
actions: Corroborate the reset with the account owner and continue proportionate monitoring
cases.verification: Confirm the expected owner activity and monitor for additional anomalous authentication
